whatsappMessage:
Hi Dr. Geeta Devi,

I noticed your dental clinic has stellar 4.9★ reviews in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new patient appointment bookings.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, multispecialty dental services, aur clinic timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/geetadevi

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Dr. Geeta Devi, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke dental clinic (Geeta Devi's Multispecialty Dental Clinic) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking and mobile-first speed for Kankarbagh patients. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dental services aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
